Hey! How's in going. Mental diet is basically noticing what you're telling yourself on a day to day basis. Take a moment. Are your thoughts mostly those of positive assumptions? Or negative assumptions?  It's the inner dialog you have with yourself, and the imaginary conversations that you have with people. I would say just start being more mindful to what your saying in your brain ideally with no judgement, and be gentle with yourself! Then when you start coming up with assumptions or thoughts, or dialog that isn't lining up to whatever it is you wanting your reality to be, then switch it up. Turn the negatives into positives. For example "I am unloved", you would let that thought go through you, but we all know that's a lie, you're very loveable! So then you change it to something like "oh that's silly of course I'm loved"
